author: mozepy
what_it_is: This DexPlorer file contains a save file for the Japanese version of Spyro the Dragon with one game completed 120% and the PocketStation game "Sparx Workout!" with 30 Dragonfly eggs. If you have a PocketStation you can raise the Dragonflies but it won't
format: DexDrive .gme cut short: '123-456-STD' 3904-byte header + only the first 98304 bytes of the card (12 of 16 blocks); the card holds 2 save(s), 2 for this game (BISCPS-10083SPYRO, BISCPSP1008300000000)

note: The converter pads the missing blocks with zeroes, as DuckStation's ImportCardGME does; the saves on the card all lie in the blocks present. one-saves (1saves convert) does not read this file: a PS1 memory card is 131072 bytes, or that behind a DexDrive, VGS or PSP header, but this file is 102208 bytes
